reference.text: Steering north-eastward from the Crozetts, we fell in with vast meadows of brit, the minute, yellow substance, upon which the Right Whale largely feeds.

underlines.text: caused by the vast drifts of brit continually floating in those latitudes

reference.text: The accursed shark alone can in any generic respect be said to bear comparative analogy to him.

underlines.text: do you not find a strange analogy to something in yourself
